script: if (-not $match.Success) { throw 'Latest verified KVRT backup release has no product/database-version field.' }

notes: The manifest tracks the verified payload's product/database build version, not only KVRT.exe's displayed executable version, so new daily database builds can trigger updates even when the executable version stays the same.
The Scoop manifest downloads from this bucket's latest verified KVRT backup release rather than Kaspersky's direct endpoint, which rejects GitHub Actions runner IPs.

The separate KVRT verification workflow validates the official executable's MZ header, size, Kaspersky Authenticode signature, and matching version before publishing it. The hash in this manifest is calculated from that verified release asset.
